SCREENPILOT SYNTHETIC CV FIXTURE
This document describes a fictional candidate created only for deterministic demo testing.

Nora Pell
Visual communication generalist
Suggested role: Graphic Designer

PROFILE
Four years of fictional experience preparing clear visual materials for small product and community initiatives. The candidate has worked across brand guidelines, campaign layouts, presentation systems, and accessible digital assets. This evidence supports a provisional Graphic Designer direction for conversation only; it does not prove an application, a real vacancy, or a hiring outcome.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Translated broad briefs into consistent visual concepts, organized feedback from several collaborators, maintained reusable asset libraries, and explained design decisions in plain language. Balanced independent focus with regular reviews and documented what changed between versions so non-design partners could follow the work.

WORK PREFERENCES
Values clear priorities, respectful critique, and enough focus time to develop coherent work. Uses English for written updates and cross-team review. Location, work arrangement, availability, compensation expectations, motivation, and the final candidate-selected role must be confirmed in conversation. No real employer, client, campaign, or person is represented.
